name: Lagen Klein
source:
The leader of the vampires who resist the ruling class in Feste Castle. He has considerable support within the Resistance. He has a small room in the basement of the castle, and mainly stays in the hideout of Widerstand. He is from the knight serving the nobility. He is usually broad-minded, but tends to act cautiously.

[From [url=https://apps.apple.com/us/app/bride-of-the-twilight/id1598260899]English App Store[/url]]
